title: Upcoming Treasury Auctions
summary: The source attempted to retrieve upcoming Treasury auction data from the U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data API but received a 404 error, indicating the requested endpoint or resource was not found. No actual auction data was retrieved.
key_points: API request returned 404 Client Error for the upcoming_auctions endpoint

No actual auction data, dates, or amounts were retrieved
